# restate_cloud_regions (Data Source)

Regions the configured Restate Cloud account may place environments in.

Use it to validate a region before an apply, or to pick one without hard-coding it. An environment's region cannot be changed after creation, so getting it wrong means replacing the environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Regions the configured account may place environments in.
#
# An environment's region cannot be changed after creation, so validating it before an apply avoids
# discovering the mistake as a replacement.

data "restate_cloud_regions" "available" {}

# Fail the plan rather than the apply if the intended region is not available to this account.
check "region_is_available" {
  assert {
    condition     = contains(data.restate_cloud_regions.available.names, var.region)
    error_message = "Region ${var.region} is not available to this account. Available: ${join(", ", data.restate_cloud_regions.available.names)}."
  }
}

resource "restate_cloud_environment" "production" {
  name   = "production"
  region = var.region
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Region names, in the order the API returned them. Convenient for `contains()` checks.
- `regions` (Attributes List) The regions, with their human-readable labels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable region label. Empty when the API reports none.
- `name` (String) Region name, as used in `restate_cloud_environment.region`.
